title: Goal Loop
description: A host-owned completion gate keeps the turn alive until trusted evidence satisfies the active goal.

steps.content: /goal until tests passed and deploy green
steps.annotation: The command defines the condition but sits outside the evidence window.
The harness, not the working model, owns the completion gate.

steps.content: Tests passed and deployment is green.
steps.annotation: Assistant prose is not trusted completion evidence.
An unmet condition pushes the loop into another bounded turn.
Only an allowlisted host event can attach a trusted evidence origin.
Trusted evidence closes the goal and releases the stop gate.
